function subtractRanges(base, blockers) {
  const baseStart = base[0];
  const baseEnd = base[1];
  if (baseStart >= baseEnd) return [];

  const intervals = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < blockers.length; i++) {
    const blocker = blockers[i];
    const start = Math.max(blocker[0], baseStart);
    const end = Math.min(blocker[1], baseEnd);
    if (start < end) intervals.push([start, end]);
  }

  intervals.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);

  const merged = [];

    const last = merged[merged.length - 1];
    if (last && interval[0] <= last[1]) {
      last[1] = Math.max(last[1], interval[1]);
    } else {
      merged.push([interval[0], interval[1]]);
    }
  }

  const result = [];
  let cursor = baseStart;
  for (const interval of merged) {
    if (interval[0] > cursor) {
      result.push([cursor, interval[0]]);
    }
    if (interval[1] > cursor) cursor = interval[1];
  }
  if (cursor < baseEnd) result.push([cursor, baseEnd]);

  return result;
}

module.exports = subtractRanges;
